primary_statistical_references.equations: A.4 Gaussian density; A.5-A.6 Gaussian marginal and conditional mean/covariance; A.11-A.13 block inverse; A.18 log determinant. Author-hosted published mathematical reference.
2.30 and Algorithm 2.1: Cholesky evaluation of a correlated Gaussian log likelihood. Here the mean is a prescribed parametric motion cube, not a Gaussian-process signal prior.

independent_library_reference.role: Dense multivariate_normal.logpdf comparison on small matrices; singular covariance is forbidden.

physics: Import the frozen emitting-ring forward law and its independently implemented direct truth; inherit all geometry, instrument, known source parameters, pressure/dynamics limitations and numerical thresholds. No source or force inference.

noise.law: K[c,d]=sigma_c*sigma_d*rho^abs(c-d); sigma_c=sigma_flux*(1+channel_modulation*cos(2*pi*c/nchannel)); s_p=1+pixel_x_modulation*x/(npix-1); C[(c,p),(d,q)]=K[c,d]*s_p^2*delta[p,q]. Added after the instrument. Independent spatial pixels and realizations.
noise.generation: Stationary Gaussian AR(1) innovations: z0=e0, zc=rho*z(c-1)+sqrt(1-rho^2)*ec; noise[c,p]=sigma_c*s_p*z[c,p]. Dense Cholesky is only an independent generator/control.

masks.measurement: All channels at spatial pixels where (x+3*y)%11 != 0; zero-based indices, fixed independent of source and noise. Removed cells are unobserved and marginalized, never set to zero as data.
masks.training: Measured pixels with (x+2*y)%3 != fold, channels c%3 != fold.
masks.heldout_pixels: Measured pixels with (x+2*y)%3 == fold, training channels.
masks.fold_dependence: Two overlapping partitions of each realization; average their metrics within a realization before summary. They are sensitivity partitions, not two independent experiments.

study.seed_mapping: NumPy PCG64 default_rng(SeedSequence([seed, case_index, realization_index, draw_index])); draw_index=0 for training/same-noise cube, 1 and 2 for independent fresh-noise cubes. Reuse each noise cube across methods and both folds for paired comparisons.

fit.starts: The two starts and all parameter bounds from the frozen prior motion config; no truth-seeded or warm-start fitting.
fit.objective: Training marginal Gaussian likelihood only, using K_TT. Never subset a full precision matrix or whiten with held-out residuals. Diagonal approximation keeps exactly the true marginal variances and discards correlations. Select start by training objective only.

comparisons.signal: Noiseless fitted mean error under the common true held-out marginal covariance; independent fresh data scored with the same marginal covariance and NO same-realization noise correction.
comparisons.same_realization: Report both marginal plug-in mean score and conditional forecast m_H + C_HT C_TT^-1(y_T-m_T) with Schur covariance C_HH-C_HT C_TT^-1 C_TH. Use each method's assumed covariance for its forecast log density including log determinant. Also report point forecast errors with common true metrics.
comparisons.noise_interpolation_negative_control: Apply the old training-noise correction to independent fresh data and to noiseless truth as an explicitly inappropriate transfer diagnostic. Score with true marginal covariance, because cross-realization covariance is zero; never use the same-noise Schur covariance for fresh data.
comparisons.oracle: Known true mean plus true covariance: noise-only marginal and conditional forecasts, and independent fresh replicates, to expose the benefit of interpolation separately from physical fitting.
comparisons.predictive_pass: Descriptive only: for each held-out subset, fresh q/N averaged over its two independent replicates <=1.25 AND noiseless mean error q/N under true marginal covariance <=0.25. All subsets must pass. Conditional same-noise scores do not count toward this criterion.
comparisons.parameter_pass: All nine absolute parameter errors within the prior motion config tolerances; this is not posterior coverage or unique identifiability.
comparisons.uncertainty: Retain all 4 realizations, 2 overlapping folds, both optimizer starts and failures. Report paired differences, means, sample SD and min/max over four realization-level fold averages. No detection significance, population claim or Monte Carlo coverage claim. Plug-in forecast covariances exclude fitted-parameter uncertainty.

definitions: Symmetry/positive-definiteness and invalid-input rejection without jitter
AR innovations covariance equals analytic K
Block whitening/logpdf vs dense inverse, determinant and SciPy Gaussian
Marginal training precision equals inverse of K_TT, not subset of full inverse
Schur conditional mean/covariance vs dense joint precision
Joint logpdf equals train marginal plus held-out conditional
Irregular fixed spatial mask and independent held-out pixels
Diagonal limit exactly removes conditioning and matches diagonal likelihood
Conditional covariance independent of response values
Fresh realization covariance is marginal with zero cross-realization gain
Oracle conditional whitened moments with frozen Monte Carlo draws
Held-out response perturbation cannot change either correct or diagonal fit
Previously frozen 25 forward-law controls replay through import

access_accounting.freeze: Freeze config, preflight and immutable prior dependencies before implementation and synthetic response generation. Numerical/statistical controls must pass before study responses.
